deadline.value: January 15 for September admission (Canadian and international); system closes that day. Year inferred.

gre_subject.quote: All foreign applicants must submit Graduate Record Examination (GRE) Physics subject score

supervisor.value: No supervisor needed to apply, but you are admitted only if at least one potential supervisor will fund you; contacting faculty first helps
supervisor.quote: Do I have to find a supervisor before I apply? No. However, contacting faculty members before applying may increase your chances of admission. We only admit students where there is at least one potential supervisor willing to provide funding.

funding.value: All admitted full-time thesis students are funded (tuition still payable)
funding.quote: All admitted full-time thesis-based students (except those who are sponsored by a company, an institution or a government) will be funded.

entry_route.value: An MSc in physics, engineering physics, astronomy/astrophysics or a related field is required; a 3-year BSc always needs an MSc first.
entry_route.quote: An MSc degree (or equivalent) in physics, engineering physics, astronomy/astrophysics or a related scientific field.

also.quote: With a 3-year B.Sc. degree, we also require a M.Sc. degree if you want to apply for our graduate program.

fee_waiver.quote: We do not have a program to waive the application fee.

english_waiver.value: Test required if your degree is from a country where English is not a native language (English-taught courses alone do not exempt you)
english_waiver.quote: English Proficiency Test is required from all applicants if their degrees are granted from institutions of countries where English is not a native language.

toefl_min.value: Faculty of Science programs need TOEFL iBT 97 with 23 in each section (5.0 with 5.0 in each section on the new scale for tests on or after January 21, 2026).
toefl_min.quote: Graduate programs in the Faculty of Science require higher minimum scores than those specified by the Faculty of Graduate Studies. | TOEFL iBT (tests taken before January 21, 2026): 97 (minimum 23 in each section) | TOEFL iBT (tests taken on or after January 21, 2026): 5.0 (minimum 5.0 in each section)

ielts_min.value: Faculty of Science programs need IELTS Academic 7.0 with at least 6.5 in each section.

notes: First-round offers take at least a month after January 15.
